translations.web: The watchmen who go about the city found me. They beat me. They bruised me. The keepers of the walls took my cloak away from me.
translations.bsb: I encountered the watchmen on their rounds of the city. They beat me and bruised me; they took away my cloak, those guardians of the walls.
translations.kjv: The watchmen that went about the city found me, they smote me, they wounded me; the keepers of the walls took away my veil
translations.asv: The watchmen that go about the city found me, They smote me, they wounded me; The keepers of the walls took away my mantle from me.
